ebbc04017197.subject: A website for Starstruck Coffee
ebbc04017197.body: Hi! I found Starstruck Coffee on the map and noticed you don't have a website yet - just a phone number and an address. I build the things that pay off fastest, end to end: a one-page site with your services and contacts, and a Telegram bot that takes bookings and orders without phone calls. Hosting and the domain are wired up by me, so you just hand people a link. Happy to put together a draft for your business at my own cost so you can see it first - no obligation either way. Would that be useful?
